GUIDANCE ANALYSIS: Analog Devices — Q1 2026

METRIC: Revenue
GUIDANCE TYPE: Quantitative
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: $3.5 billion, +/- $100 million
UNIT: USD
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal Q2 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Quarter
BASIS: Reported/company revenue outlook; no organic or constant-currency basis stated.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Management cited broad Industrial strength, record Data Center orders, cyclical recovery, and secular growth tailwinds.
- Macro and geopolitical conditions remain challenging.

METRIC: Revenue growth
GUIDANCE TYPE: Quantitative
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: About 11% sequential growth at the midpoint; excluding pricing uplift, more like 7% sequential growth
UNIT: sequential growth
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal Q2 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Quarter
BASIS: Company revenue outlook at midpoint; reported basis not otherwise specified.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- About one-third of the midpoint quarter-over-quarter revenue increase is expected to come from pricing.
- Excluding pricing, expected growth remains above typical Q2 seasonality of 4%-5%.

METRIC: Reported operating margin
GUIDANCE TYPE: Quantitative
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: Approximately 36.4%, +/- 150 basis points
UNIT: percent
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal Q2 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Quarter
BASIS: GAAP; at the midpoint of the revenue outlook.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Formal earnings-release outlook.

METRIC: Adjusted operating margin
GUIDANCE TYPE: Quantitative
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: Approximately 47.5%, +/- 100 basis points
UNIT: percent
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal Q2 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Quarter
BASIS: Adjusted/non-GAAP; at the midpoint of the revenue outlook.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Expected sequential improvement reflects gross-margin expansion and lower OpEx as a percentage of revenue.

METRIC: Reported diluted EPS
GUIDANCE TYPE: Quantitative
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: $2.19, +/- $0.15
UNIT: USD per diluted share
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal Q2 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Quarter
BASIS: GAAP.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Formal earnings-release outlook.

METRIC: Adjusted diluted EPS
GUIDANCE TYPE: Quantitative
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: $2.88, +/- $0.15
UNIT: USD per diluted share
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal Q2 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Quarter
BASIS: Adjusted/non-GAAP.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Based on the revenue, operating-margin, and tax-rate outlook inputs.

METRIC: Tax rate
GUIDANCE TYPE: Quantitative
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: Between 11% and 13%
UNIT: percent
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal Q2 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Quarter
BASIS: Management earnings-model outlook; the call did not explicitly label this range GAAP or non-GAAP.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Used as an input to the adjusted EPS outlook.

METRIC: Adjusted gross margin
GUIDANCE TYPE: Quantitative
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: 100 basis points of reported sequential expansion; essentially 150 basis points versus Q1 excluding Q1 discrete items
UNIT: basis points
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal Q2 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Quarter
BASIS: Non-GAAP/adjusted gross-margin bridge discussed on the call.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Favorable mix and pricing are expected to drive the increase.
- Management expects only modest further upside from utilization because it has moved closer to the optimal utilization level.
- The outlook includes 50 basis points from one-time channel-inventory repricing.

METRIC: Channel-inventory repricing contribution to gross margin
GUIDANCE TYPE: Quantitative
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: 50 basis points will not repeat
UNIT: basis points
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal Q3 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Quarter
BASIS: Non-GAAP/adjusted gross-margin outlook; relates to the one-time effect of repricing inventory in the channel.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- The Q2 price-related margin uplift from channel inventory repricing is one-time and therefore is not expected to recur in Q3.

METRIC: Operating expenses growth
GUIDANCE TYPE: Quantitative
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: Mid-single-digit growth
UNIT: sequential growth
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal Q2 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Quarter
BASIS: Operating-expense outlook; non-GAAP basis consistent with management's call remarks.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- No shutdown is expected in Q2.
- ADI is continuing to hire in strategic investment areas.
- Higher bonus factor and the GTC conference are expected expense drivers.

METRIC: Operating expenses growth relative to revenue growth
GUIDANCE TYPE: Quantitative
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: OpEx growth expected to trail revenue growth by roughly half
UNIT: relative growth rate
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Full Year
BASIS: Full-year operating-expense growth outlook; non-GAAP basis consistent with management's call remarks.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Management expects operating leverage to continue as revenue grows.

METRIC: Capital expenditures
GUIDANCE TYPE: Quantitative
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: 4%-6% of revenue
UNIT: percent of revenue
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Full Year
BASIS: Capital expenditures within ADI's long-term model.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Capex is expected to support operations and strategic investments.

METRIC: Industrial revenue growth
GUIDANCE TYPE: Quantitative
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: Up 20% sequentially and about 50% year over year
UNIT: revenue growth
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal Q2 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Quarter
BASIS: End-market revenue outlook; reported basis not otherwise specified.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Cyclical recovery.
- Strength in automated test equipment (ATE) and aerospace and defense.
- Management expects all Industrial segments to increase.

METRIC: ATE revenue growth within Industrial
GUIDANCE TYPE: Quantitative
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: Greater than 30% sequential growth
UNIT: sequential revenue growth
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal Q2 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Quarter
BASIS: Industrial end-market outlook; reported basis not otherwise specified.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- ATE is expected to lead Industrial growth amid strong bookings and backlog.

METRIC: Communications revenue growth
GUIDANCE TYPE: Quantitative
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: Up high single digits sequentially and about 60% year over year
UNIT: revenue growth
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal Q2 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Quarter
BASIS: End-market revenue outlook; reported basis not otherwise specified.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- AI-driven data-center demand for optical and power portfolios.
- Wireless cyclical recovery.

METRIC: Automotive revenue growth
GUIDANCE TYPE: Quantitative
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: Flat to down sequentially
UNIT: sequential revenue growth
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal Q2 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Quarter
BASIS: End-market revenue outlook; reported basis not otherwise specified.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Below-seasonal outlook is attributed to the unwind of tariff- and macro-related order pull-ins.
- Greater China exposure is typically seasonally light in Q2 because of Chinese New Year.

METRIC: Consumer revenue growth
GUIDANCE TYPE: Quantitative
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: Down mid-single digits sequentially
UNIT: sequential revenue growth
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal Q2 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Quarter
BASIS: End-market revenue outlook; reported basis not otherwise specified.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Expected to be in line with normal seasonality.

METRIC: Revenue growth
GUIDANCE TYPE: Quantitative
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: Typically up low single digits
UNIT: sequential growth
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal Q3 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Quarter
BASIS: Typical company seasonal pattern; management explicitly stated it does not otherwise guide Q3.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Management characterized this as normal Q3 seasonality rather than a formal Q3 outlook.

METRIC: Pricing contribution to revenue growth
GUIDANCE TYPE: Quantitative
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: About one-third of the midpoint quarter-over-quarter revenue increase
UNIT: share of sequential revenue increase
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal Q2 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Quarter
BASIS: Midpoint company revenue outlook; contribution from recent pricing actions.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Recent channel-partner price adjustments took effect at the start of Q2.
- Annual direct-customer negotiations are largely complete, so Q2 is expected to reflect the full scope of recent pricing actions.
- Roughly half of the price lift is related to channel-inventory repricing.

METRIC: Pricing contribution to revenue growth
GUIDANCE TYPE: Quantitative
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: About 50 basis points of incremental growth in each quarter
UNIT: basis points of sequential revenue growth
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal Q3 and Fiscal Q4 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Multi Year
BASIS: Incremental sequential revenue-growth contribution from pricing.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Excludes the nonrecurring Q2 benefit from repricing channel inventory.

METRIC: Automotive revenue
GUIDANCE TYPE: Qualitative
NUMERICAL GUIDANCE: None stated; use management rationale only
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Full Year
BASIS: End-market revenue outlook; reported basis not otherwise specified.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Management expects Automotive to grow versus record fiscal 2025 after first-half headwinds pass.
- Underlying content growth and share positions, including connectivity and functionally safe power for ADAS, remain intact.

METRIC: Data-center and automated-test-equipment growth
GUIDANCE TYPE: Quantitative
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: Double-digit growth
UNIT: growth rate
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Over the next several years
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Multi Year
BASIS: Management long-term growth outlook for these areas.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- AI infrastructure demand supports data-center optical and power portfolios.
- Increasing semiconductor complexity and connected intelligent devices support ATE demand.

METRIC: Customer ordering and inventory restocking
GUIDANCE TYPE: Qualitative
NUMERICAL GUIDANCE: None stated; use management rationale only
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Not explicitly stated
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Not Stated
BASIS: Demand and channel-inventory outlook.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Management believes customers are broadly nearing, or are, ordering to consumption after digestion.
- Management sees no evidence of restocking activity across its portfolio.

METRIC: Fiscal 2026 overall business outlook
GUIDANCE TYPE: Qualitative
NUMERICAL GUIDANCE: None stated; use management rationale only
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Full Year
BASIS: Management overall company outlook.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Management believes fiscal 2026 has the potential to be a banner year, supported by a strong Q2 outlook and improving demand signals.
- This outlook is conditional on no unforeseen material changes in the macroeconomic and geopolitical backdrop.

METRIC: Free-cash-flow return to shareholders
GUIDANCE TYPE: Quantitative
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: 100% of free cash flow returned to shareholders; 40%-60% used for dividends and the remainder for share-count reduction
UNIT: percent of free cash flow
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Over the long term
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Multi Year
BASIS: Long-term capital-return target.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Management intends to use dividends and share repurchases/share-count reduction to return free cash flow to shareholders.

METRIC: Quarterly cash dividend
GUIDANCE TYPE: Quantitative
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: $1.10 per outstanding share; expected total approximately $537 million
UNIT: USD per share; USD total
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: March 17, 2026 payment date
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Date Range
BASIS: Board-declared quarterly cash dividend.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Payable to shareholders of record at the close of business on March 3, 2026.

METRIC: Quarterly dividends
GUIDANCE TYPE: Qualitative
NUMERICAL GUIDANCE: None stated; use management rationale only
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Future periods
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Other
BASIS: Capital-allocation outlook.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Management currently expects quarterly dividends to continue, subject to Board determination and declaration.
- Future dividends depend on financial performance, outlook, and liquidity.

COMPARABLE EARNINGS ANALYSIS: Analog Devices — Q2 2026
STRICT REPORT WINDOW: 2026-04-05 to 2026-05-19

COMPARABLE: Texas Instruments (TXN)
REPORT DATE: 2026-04-22
REPORTED PERIOD: Q1 2026 (three months ended March 31, 2026)
WHY COMPARABLE: Direct large-scale analog and embedded-semiconductor comparable. Its reported analog demand and end-market trends are directly relevant to Analog Devices through overlapping industrial, automotive, communications-equipment and data-center signal-chain/power demand.
SHARED EXPOSURES:
- Industrial automation and broad industrial semiconductor demand
- Automotive semiconductor demand
- Data-center power and signal-chain content
- Communications-equipment demand
- Analog semiconductor cycle and customer inventory/capacity conditions
TRANSFERABLE EARNINGS POINTS:
- Broad industrial-demand acceleration [INDUSTRY, POSITIVE]
  IMPACT ON COMPARABLE: TI said industrial revenue increased more than 20% sequentially and more than 30% year over year, broadly across sectors and regions. Total Q1 revenue was $4.825 billion, up 9% sequentially; the company identified industrial as a principal contributor to revenue above its outlook range.
  READ-THROUGH TO TARGET: Positive demand read-through for Analog Devices' industrial exposure, but not a percentage transfer: customer mix, channel model, product content and fiscal-period timing can differ.
  SOURCE: https://investor.ti.com/static-files/9d0b308f-8b7e-4e0c-9377-5fa5877243fe
- Data-center and communications-equipment demand [INDUSTRY, POSITIVE]
  IMPACT ON COMPARABLE: TI reported data-center revenue up more than 25% sequentially and about 90% year over year; communications-equipment revenue was up more than 30% sequentially and about 25% year over year. The company said the overall semiconductor-market recovery was continuing.
  READ-THROUGH TO TARGET: Constructive read-through for Analog Devices products exposed to data-center power/signal-chain and communications infrastructure. The strength may not translate proportionately because TI's sockets and customer base differ.
  SOURCE: https://investor.ti.com/static-files/9d0b308f-8b7e-4e0c-9377-5fa5877243fe
- Automotive demand [INDUSTRY, NEUTRAL]
  IMPACT ON COMPARABLE: TI reported automotive revenue approximately flat sequentially, although up mid-single digits year over year.
  READ-THROUGH TO TARGET: Offsets some of the stronger industrial and data-center signal: the reported automotive environment does not support assuming a broad sequential automotive uplift for Analog Devices.
  SOURCE: https://investor.ti.com/static-files/9d0b308f-8b7e-4e0c-9377-5fa5877243fe
- Higher utilization associated with recovery [INDUSTRY, POSITIVE]
  IMPACT ON COMPARABLE: TI's gross profit margin was 58.0% of revenue, up 210 basis points sequentially, alongside 9% sequential revenue growth. This is consistent with favorable volume/utilization leverage during recovery, although TI did not quantify a standalone industry-price effect.
  READ-THROUGH TO TARGET: Directionally favorable for Analog Devices gross-margin and profit conversion if it experiences comparable incremental factory utilization; no basis exists to carry over TI's 210-basis-point change.
  SOURCE: https://investor.ti.com/static-files/9d0b308f-8b7e-4e0c-9377-5fa5877243fe
EARNINGS SOURCE: https://investor.ti.com/news-releases/news-release-details/ti-reports-first-quarter-2026-financial-results-and-shareholder
EARNINGS SOURCE: https://investor.ti.com/static-files/9d0b308f-8b7e-4e0c-9377-5fa5877243fe

COMPARABLE: NXP Semiconductors (NXPI)
REPORT DATE: 2026-04-28
REPORTED PERIOD: Q1 2026 (three months ended March 29, 2026)
WHY COMPARABLE: Direct automotive and industrial/IoT semiconductor comparable, with overlapping analog, mixed-signal, processing, connectivity and edge-system content in industrial automation and vehicles.
SHARED EXPOSURES:
- Automotive semiconductor production and content demand
- Industrial and IoT demand
- Communications infrastructure and edge-computing demand
- Semiconductor channel inventory and production planning
TRANSFERABLE EARNINGS POINTS:
- Industrial and IoT demand [INDUSTRY, POSITIVE]
  IMPACT ON COMPARABLE: NXP's Industrial & IoT revenue was $628 million, up 24% year over year, though down 2% sequentially. Management described broad-based improvement across its focus end markets.
  READ-THROUGH TO TARGET: Positive year-over-year industrial-cycle evidence for Analog Devices, tempered by the sequential decline and by NXP's processor-heavy product mix.
  SOURCE: https://investors.nxp.com/news-releases/news-release-details/nxp-semiconductors-reports-first-quarter-2026-results/
- Automotive demand [INDUSTRY, MIXED]
  IMPACT ON COMPARABLE: NXP automotive revenue was $1.782 billion, up 6% year over year but down 5% sequentially.
  READ-THROUGH TO TARGET: Indicates underlying year-over-year automotive improvement but no clean sequential uplift. This is a mixed read-through for Analog Devices' automotive business rather than a basis for a numerical extrapolation.
  SOURCE: https://investors.nxp.com/news-releases/news-release-details/nxp-semiconductors-reports-first-quarter-2026-results/
- Communications-infrastructure demand [INDUSTRY, POSITIVE]
  IMPACT ON COMPARABLE: NXP communications infrastructure and other revenue was $380 million, up 14% sequentially and 21% year over year.
  READ-THROUGH TO TARGET: Constructive for Analog Devices infrastructure-oriented signal-chain exposure, while recognizing that NXP's reported category includes products and applications not shared with Analog Devices.
  SOURCE: https://investors.nxp.com/news-releases/news-release-details/nxp-semiconductors-reports-first-quarter-2026-results/
EARNINGS SOURCE: https://investors.nxp.com/news-releases/news-release-details/nxp-semiconductors-reports-first-quarter-2026-results/

COMPARABLE: Monolithic Power Systems (MPWR)
REPORT DATE: 2026-04-30
REPORTED PERIOD: Q1 2026 (three months ended March 31, 2026)
WHY COMPARABLE: Direct power-management semiconductor comparable. Its disclosed automotive, industrial, communications and enterprise-data power trends provide a targeted read-through to Analog Devices' power and data-center-related demand, rather than merely a broad semiconductor comparison.
SHARED EXPOSURES:
- Power-management content in AI servers and data centers
- Automotive power and ADAS demand
- Industrial power demand
- Communications and networking power demand
TRANSFERABLE EARNINGS POINTS:
- AI-server and enterprise-data power demand [INDUSTRY, POSITIVE]
  IMPACT ON COMPARABLE: MPS enterprise-data revenue was $262.8 million, up 12.6% sequentially and 97.7% year over year, driven by higher sales of power-management solutions for AI and server applications.
  READ-THROUGH TO TARGET: Positive directional signal for Analog Devices data-center power and associated signal-chain demand, but MPS's concentrated AI-server exposure is not a valid percentage proxy for Analog Devices.
  SOURCE: https://www.monolithicpower.com/media/investor-relations/press-releases/Q1_2026_MPS_Earnings_Commentary.pdf
- Communications and networking power demand [INDUSTRY, POSITIVE]
  IMPACT ON COMPARABLE: MPS communications revenue was $111.5 million, up 33.1% sequentially and 55.5% year over year, primarily from higher power-solution sales for optical modules and switches.
  READ-THROUGH TO TARGET: Constructive for Analog Devices infrastructure exposure, especially where demand is linked to networking equipment. The product-level overlap is partial.
  SOURCE: https://www.monolithicpower.com/media/investor-relations/press-releases/Q1_2026_MPS_Earnings_Commentary.pdf
- Automotive and industrial demand divergence [INDUSTRY, MIXED]
  IMPACT ON COMPARABLE: MPS automotive revenue rose 0.9% sequentially, with higher ADAS power-solution sales partly offset by lower USB sales. Industrial revenue declined 11.2% sequentially. Non-GAAP gross margin was flat sequentially at 55.5%.
  READ-THROUGH TO TARGET: The mixed auto/industrial evidence argues against applying the stronger data-center and communications results broadly to Analog Devices' industrial or automotive revenue, or to its gross margin.
  SOURCE: https://www.monolithicpower.com/media/investor-relations/press-releases/Q1_2026_MPS_Earnings_Commentary.pdf
EARNINGS SOURCE: https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/04/30/3285426/0/en/monolithic-power-systems-reports-first-quarter-results-on-april-30-2026.html
EARNINGS SOURCE: https://www.monolithicpower.com/media/investor-relations/press-releases/Q1_2026_MPS_Earnings_Commentary.pdf

COMPARABLE: onsemi (ON)
REPORT DATE: 2026-05-04
REPORTED PERIOD: Q1 2026 (quarter ended April 3, 2026)
WHY COMPARABLE: Direct power, sensing and automotive/industrial semiconductor comparable with overlapping electrification, industrial automation and data-center power exposures.
SHARED EXPOSURES:
- Automotive electrification and vehicle electronics
- Industrial automation and energy infrastructure
- AI data-center power demand
- Power-management and sensing semiconductor cycle
TRANSFERABLE EARNINGS POINTS:
- Strengthening semiconductor demand and AI-data-center power demand [INDUSTRY, POSITIVE]
  IMPACT ON COMPARABLE: onsemi stated that demand strengthened during Q1 and that AI-data-center business grew more than 30% sequentially and more than doubled year over year. Total revenue was $1.513 billion, down 1% sequentially but up 5% year over year.
  READ-THROUGH TO TARGET: Positive for Analog Devices data-center-oriented power/signal-chain demand, but onsemi's AI power-tree exposure and growth rate should not be transferred to Analog Devices.
  SOURCE: https://investor.onsemi.com/news-releases/news-release-details/onsemi-reports-first-quarter-2026-results
- Automotive and industrial end-market conditions [INDUSTRY, MIXED]
  IMPACT ON COMPARABLE: onsemi described long-term opportunities in automotive and industrial applications, but its Advanced Mobility Group revenue declined 3% sequentially and its Intelligent Sensing Group declined 5% sequentially. Its Power Solutions Group increased 2% sequentially.
  READ-THROUGH TO TARGET: Mixed sector read-through: power demand improved modestly, while reported automotive/sensing trends do not substantiate a broad sequential improvement assumption for Analog Devices.
  SOURCE: https://investor.onsemi.com/news-releases/news-release-details/onsemi-reports-first-quarter-2026-results
- Volume and operating leverage in recovery [INDUSTRY, POSITIVE]
  IMPACT ON COMPARABLE: GAAP gross margin rose to 38.5% from 36.0% sequentially, while non-GAAP gross margin rose to 38.5% from 38.2%. Management attributed operating-income improvement to operating leverage and an optimized cost structure as market conditions improved.
  READ-THROUGH TO TARGET: Directionally supportive of Analog Devices margin conversion if its volume and factory-utilization trajectory similarly improves, but onsemi's manufacturing mix and starting margin are too different for a numerical gross-margin transfer.
  SOURCE: https://investor.onsemi.com/news-releases/news-release-details/onsemi-reports-first-quarter-2026-results
EARNINGS SOURCE: https://investor.onsemi.com/news-releases/news-release-details/onsemi-reports-first-quarter-2026-results

COMPARABLE: Microchip Technology (MCHP)
REPORT DATE: 2026-05-07
REPORTED PERIOD: Q4 fiscal 2026 (three months ended March 31, 2026)
WHY COMPARABLE: Direct analog, microcontroller, mixed-signal and embedded-control comparable. Its disclosed recovery in customer inventory, bookings, sell-through and industrial operating leverage is relevant to Analog Devices' broad industrial and embedded semiconductor exposure.
SHARED EXPOSURES:
- Industrial and embedded-control demand
- Automotive and broad-market semiconductor demand
- Distribution/channel inventory normalization
- Customer bookings, sell-through and expedite activity
- Recovery-phase volume and operating leverage
TRANSFERABLE EARNINGS POINTS:
- Broad demand recovery and channel-inventory normalization [INDUSTRY, POSITIVE]
  IMPACT ON COMPARABLE: Microchip reported March-quarter net sales of $1.311 billion, up 10.6% sequentially and 35.1% year over year. Management attributed the result to broad-based improvement, improved demand conditions, normalized customer inventory, stronger bookings and sell-through, and strong expedite activity.
  READ-THROUGH TO TARGET: Positive recovery-cycle signal for Analog Devices, particularly in broad industrial/embedded channels. It is not a direct numerical read-through because Microchip's customer mix, distributor concentration and recovery starting point differ.
  SOURCE: https://ir.microchip.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000827054-26-000012/exhibit991q4fy26.htm
- Recovery-phase volume leverage [INDUSTRY, POSITIVE]
  IMPACT ON COMPARABLE: Microchip's Q4 fiscal 2026 non-GAAP gross margin was 61.6%, versus 52.0% in the prior-year quarter, while non-GAAP EPS was $0.57, above its prior $0.48-to-$0.52 guidance range. Management cited meaningful operating leverage alongside improving demand.
  READ-THROUGH TO TARGET: Supports the qualitative proposition that a broad analog/embedded recovery can aid profitability. The change contains company-specific recovery and cost actions, so it cannot support a transferable gross-margin or EPS percentage.
  SOURCE: https://ir.microchip.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000827054-26-000012/exhibit991q4fy26.htm
- Near-term demand momentum [INDUSTRY, POSITIVE]
  IMPACT ON COMPARABLE: For the June 2026 quarter, Microchip guided to $1.456 billion at the midpoint, implying 11.0% sequential sales growth. This was guidance given in the qualifying May 7, 2026 earnings release.
  READ-THROUGH TO TARGET: Provides a positive near-term broad-market demand indicator, but remains a guidance datapoint for Microchip rather than evidence that Analog Devices has the same order cadence or channel exposure.
  SOURCE: https://ir.microchip.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000827054-26-000012/exhibit991q4fy26.htm
EARNINGS SOURCE: https://ir.microchip.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000827054-26-000012/exhibit991q4fy26.htm

PRELIMINARY COMPARABLE-ONLY METRIC ADD-ONS:
- Revenue: 0 USDm (NEUTRAL)
  CALCULATION: Signed comparable signal is qualitatively positive but numerically non-transferable. Calculation: 0 USDm = no defensible Analog Devices-specific scaling of the qualifying peers' reported revenue/end-market changes. A valid conversion would require Analog Devices revenue base × relevant end-market mix × peer-to-Analog-Devices exposure coefficient × fiscal-period alignment. Those target-company inputs are prohibited by the requested comparable-only methodology, and the peers provide conflicting industrial, automotive and product-mix signals.
  ASSUMPTION: Only the five qualifying earnings releases above are used.
  ASSUMPTION: Industrial and data-center signals were positive at TXN and MCHP, while NXP, MPS and onsemi showed mixed sequential automotive and/or industrial outcomes.
  ASSUMPTION: No target-company revenue base, target end-market mix, order data, pricing data, channel inventory data or later result was used.
  ASSUMPTION: Zero is therefore the central signed add-on under the instruction to return zero where there is no defensible mapping.
  SOURCE: https://investor.ti.com/static-files/9d0b308f-8b7e-4e0c-9377-5fa5877243fe
  SOURCE: https://investors.nxp.com/news-releases/news-release-details/nxp-semiconductors-reports-first-quarter-2026-results/
  SOURCE: https://www.monolithicpower.com/media/investor-relations/press-releases/Q1_2026_MPS_Earnings_Commentary.pdf
  SOURCE: https://investor.onsemi.com/news-releases/news-release-details/onsemi-reports-first-quarter-2026-results
  SOURCE: https://ir.microchip.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000827054-26-000012/exhibit991q4fy26.htm
- Adjusted diluted EPS: 0 USD / share (NEUTRAL)
  CALCULATION: 0.00 USD/share = Revenue add-on (0 USDm) × an unprovided Analog Devices incremental after-tax profit-conversion rate ÷ an unprovided Analog Devices adjusted diluted-share count. Peer EPS changes were not transferred because they embed different tax rates, share counts, capital structures, non-GAAP definitions, manufacturing models and company-specific operating-cost actions.
  ASSUMPTION: Only qualifying comparable releases are used.
  ASSUMPTION: No target-company margin, tax, interest, other-income or share-count input was used.
  ASSUMPTION: TI's discrete tax benefit, NXP's asset-sale gain, and company-specific restructuring or cost actions at other peers were excluded from the mapping.
  ASSUMPTION: Zero is required because no defensible comparable-only conversion exists from peer demand data to Analog Devices adjusted diluted EPS.
  SOURCE: https://investor.ti.com/static-files/9d0b308f-8b7e-4e0c-9377-5fa5877243fe

events.title: Opening of advanced manufacturing and test facility in Chonburi, Thailand
events.summary: Analog Devices announced the opening of an advanced manufacturing facility in Chonburi, Thailand. The site expands manufacturing and test capacity for wafer-level processing, chip-scale packaging and final integrated-circuit test, serving industrial, automotive, communications, consumer and healthcare markets. ADI described the expansion as part of its hybrid internal-factory, foundry and OSAT manufacturing strategy.
source_headlines: Analog Devices Strengthens Global Manufacturing Resilience with New Thailand Facility

events.title: Agreement to acquire Empower Semiconductor for $1.5 billion in cash
events.summary: Analog Devices and Empower Semiconductor entered a definitive agreement under which ADI will acquire Empower for $1.5 billion in cash. Empower's silicon capacitors were already in production, and its integrated-voltage-regulator programs were advancing with leading hyperscalers and AI-silicon providers. The transaction was expected to close in the second half of calendar 2026, subject to customary closing conditions and Hart-Scott-Rodino review.
source_headlines: Analog Devices to Acquire Empower Semiconductor, Expanding its Next-Generation High-Density Power Portfolio for the AI Era

metric_impacts.metric_total_calculation: Derived Q2 adjusted diluted EPS forecast = $2.88 per share, rounded: [(Q2 revenue $3,500m × adjusted operating margin 47.5%) - adjusted net nonoperating expense $53.305m] × (1 - 12.0%) ÷ 491.656m diluted shares = $2.880. Change versus prior reported adjusted diluted EPS of $2.46 = +$0.42. Total change equals GUIDANCE (+$0.42) + E1 ($0.00) + E2 ($0.00) + COMPARABLES ($0.00).

event_contributions.affected_line: Sales volume, selling price, gross-margin mix, COGS utilization, and adjusted operating expenses.
event_contributions.transmission_path: Guided revenue, gross-margin expansion/mix and lower adjusted OpEx as a percentage of revenue produce a guided 47.5% adjusted operating margin. Adjusted operating income less adjusted net nonoperating expense yields pretax income; applying the 12% guided tax-rate midpoint and diluted shares derives EPS.
assumptions: Standalone fiscal-quarter alignment: management specifically guided Q2 FY2026 revenue, adjusted operating margin, adjusted EPS and tax rate; no annual interpolation is required.
Use the tax-rate midpoint of 12.0% from the 11%-13% guidance range.
Use Q1 adjusted net nonoperating expense of $53.305m as the unchanged Q2 central estimate because no Q2-specific nonoperating-expense outlook was supplied.
Use Q1 diluted shares of 491.656m as a conservative share-count estimate; management's repurchase program creates modest potential upside but no Q2 share-count guidance was disclosed.
The resulting $2.880 is a derived result that reconciles to, rather than copies, management's $2.88 adjusted-EPS midpoint.
event_contributions.calculation: GUIDANCE synthetic event, operating-margin route: adjusted operating income = $3,500m × 47.5% = $1,662.500m. Pretax adjusted income = $1,662.500m - $53.305m + $0m = $1,609.195m. Adjusted net income = $1,609.195m × (1 - 12.0%) + $0m = $1,416.092m. Derived adjusted diluted EPS = $1,416.092m ÷ 491.656m = $2.880. Change versus prior reported $2.46 = +$0.42/share.
